honest_summary: The only DURABLE, on-disk artifacts are committed eval-result JSON and the local memory file. Application logs go to stderr (ephemeral), telemetry spans + the executed-hash ledger are in-process, and LangSmith is observability — none is an append-only retained compliance log. That gap is tracked (HARDENING-BACKLOG.md, S2/M).
